title: $3.5 billion large investment abatement created in special session
notes: Full 10-year abatement of personal property and modified business taxes plus a partial sales and use tax abatement. Used for the Tesla Gigafactory award.

title: S.B. 170 creates the data center and aviation abatement programs
notes: Establishes the 10-year and 20-year data center tiers: sales and use tax rate reduced to 2 percent and 75 percent of personal property tax abated.

title: Legislature adds the $1 billion large investment project program
notes: Added later in the same year as S.B. 170.

title: GASB Statement No. 77 takes effect, requiring tax abatement disclosure
notes: Before FY2017, governments were not required to disclose tax abatement agreements in their financial statements. This is why redeemed-abatement series begin in FY2017.

title: Co-located data centers excluded from public utility regulation
notes: See testimony on S.B. 547 at page 14.

title: Reno City Council votes against data center regulations
notes: Proposed regulations covered water and power usage and noise levels.

title: Sparks City Council directs staff to draft data center regulations
City of Reno publishes GOED abatements overview
notes: First municipal quantification of redeemed abatement impacts on Reno revenues, FY2017-FY2024.

title: LCB briefs joint interim committees on data centers
notes: Delivered to the Joint Interim Standing Committees on Natural Resources and on Growth and Infrastructure. Inventories roughly 70 Nevada data center locations.

title: Reno data center moratorium reported passed
notes: Reported by the Truckee Meadows Data Center Policy Consortium (datacenter.policyconsortium.org). Not yet confirmed against Reno City Council minutes or ordinance text. Do not cite from this dataset until verified.

title: GOED approves nine companies including Colovore Reno 1
notes: More than $17.6 million in abatements across Clark, Washoe, Storey and Lyon counties. Six of the nine companies were not named in available coverage.
